abc-soru-kemer.soru: What shape is the arch covering the front of Alaaddin Bey Fountain?
ipuclari: Look at the top of the red and white arch in the photograph.
Its top does not curve round; it meets at a point in the middle.
abc-soru-kemer.dogru_metin: The wide pointed arch covering nearly the whole front is common in early Bursa fountains; it is built of white travertine with bricks set between.
abc-soru-kemer.yanlis_metin: Try again. You can ask for a hint below.
